visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short black hair, wearing a black t-shirt with a green sleeve detail and dark sweatpants, stands in a brightly lit living room. He holds a large teal and black toy weapon, striking several heroic poses toward the camera. A large television and various toy storage boxes are visible in the background. (2) The camera zooms in on the boy as he points the toy device forward, with white circular graphics appearing around him. He smiles excitedly at the lens. (3) A cut reveals an adult man wearing glasses, a tan tank top, and large over-ear headphones, sitting in a dark room with a professional microphone. He is talking and smiling while a hand enters from the side holding a promotional card. (4) An adult woman with reddish-brown hair appears, holding up a black shirt inside a clear plastic bag featuring an Ultraman graphic. She looks directly at the camera while speaking. (5) Back in the living room, the boy demonstrates more dynamic poses with the toy, accompanied by blue digital lightning effects overlaid on the screen. (6) The woman and the boy stand together in a hallway, both wearing matching black hoodies, pointing at the graphics on their clothing. They then sit on the floor in a kitchen area with their palms together as if in prayer. (7) An exterior shot shows the orange neon sign of a 'COSMED' store. Inside the store, the woman and boy browse shelves and pick out items, placing them into a black shopping basket. (8) At the store counter, the boy watches as an orange-uniformed clerk hands over several 'Ultraman' themed scratch cards. The boy excitedly scratches one of the cards at a table, revealing a character illustration. (9) The woman holds up a large promotional poster in the store, pointing to images of a car, a scooter, and an iPhone. (10) Finally, the woman and boy are back home, holding a fan of cards and smiling at the camera while concluding their talk.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched female voice energetically saying 'Ultraman.' An upbeat, fast-tempo electronic pop track with a strong drum machine beat starts immediately. (2) A sharp percussive 'ding' SFX punctuates the start of a new phase, followed by a digital 'zap' laser sound as graphics appear. (3) The female voice shifts into a narrative tone, explaining the Ultraman connection, while a short 'whoosh' transition sound occurs. (4) A male voice is heard laughing and talking in a casual, warm tone; a pre-recorded laugh track SFX is briefly layered into the mix. (5) Several rapid-fire impact SFX and swooshing sounds are heard as the boy performs movements. The BGM remains consistent in rhythm. (6) A child's high-pitched voice speaks a short phrase with excitement, followed by more bubble-pop UI sound effects. (7) A clear, professional narration by the female speaker takes over to describe promotional rules; a bell chime SFX sounds every time a key prize is mentioned. (8) The video concludes with the BGM swelling slightly before a final hard cut to silence as the voices finish.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Explanation -> Promotion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a commercial promotion for a collaboration between COSMED and Ultraman. It uses a high-energy, family-friendly vlog style to attract parents and children, demonstrating Ultraman-themed apparel and toys before pivoting to an informative breakdown of a store-based scratch card event with valuable prizes like cars and electronics.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of store location (COSMED), clear exhibition of promotional materials, and detailed explanation of event dates and prizes.
